prompt: A wide landscape-oriented minimalist promotional poster for a city book exhibition, set on a warm off-white background with a subtle paper-grain texture, the overall palette restrained, using deep charcoal black for typography and soft warm beige tones for shadows and objects. Across the upper-left to upper-center of the frame, a large Chinese main headline reads "纸上春秋", set in an elegant calligraphic serif typeface with slightly hand-brushed ink variation, dark charcoal gray-black, the four characters spaced generously so they occupy the dominant visual band of the upper half; a small square cinnabar-red seal stamp sits just below the right edge of the headline, its carved characters too small to read clearly. Directly beneath the headline, a smaller centered subheading in clean sans-serif Chinese reads "第12届城市书展", dark gray, flanked on both sides by short thin horizontal lines in the same tone, forming a quiet formal divider around the text. In the lower-right quadrant of the frame, a quiet still life: a single paperback book lies on a pale wooden tabletop with its cover facing upward, angled slightly in perspective so its spine and cream-colored page block are visible along its left edge; the cover is matte tan-brown with a lightly textured finish resembling aged paper, and faint botanical linework of stems, narrow leaves and small flowers is printed on it in pale brown-gray. Across the bottom edge of the frame, the wooden tabletop runs horizontally, showing subtle wood grain lines and a soft sunlit highlight, and the book casts one long gentle shadow to the lower right. In the upper-right background, soft blurred shadows of plant leaves fall diagonally across the off-white surface, semi-transparent beige-gray and diffuse-edged, suggesting daylight passing through foliage off-frame. The lighting is soft diffused daylight from the upper left, gently and evenly illuminating the poster surface with no hard edges. The overall composition is a balanced minimalist layout with generous negative space, refined alignment, a warm off-white and charcoal palette, and a calm literary mood, mixing graphic poster typography with a quiet realistic still life.

A wide landscape travel photograph of a highway sign gantry on a clear summer day, shot from driver's-eye level on a multi-lane expressway, the frame dominated by a long green overhead directional sign mounted on a grey steel portal spanning the full width of the road. Across the upper center of the frame, the sign face is a glossy green panel with a thin white border; white sans-serif uppercase text on its left section reads "BEIJING", a white right-pointing arrow sits in the middle of the panel, and a smaller white line on the right section reads "20km", the lettering clean and evenly spaced against the green background. In the lower two thirds of the frame, the expressway stretches straight ahead, light grey asphalt with white dashed lane lines converging toward the horizon, a few cars far ahead whose details are small and slightly indistinct with distance. Along the right edge of the road a concrete barrier runs into the distance, and beyond it low green shrubbery and a line of leafy trees. The upper third of the frame is open sky, pale blue with a few thin high clouds, the sun high so shadows fall short, directly beneath the sign structure. The lighting is bright hard midday sunlight, a slight highlight streak crosses the glossy top edge of the sign, and the road surface is dry and faintly hazy toward the horizon. The overall composition is a centered symmetrical travel shot with a strong sense of depth, a palette of sky blue, sign green and neutral grey, and an open sunlit on-the-road mood.

把这张照片的背景整体替换为巴黎卢浮宫玻璃金字塔前的庭院场景，并把取景补足为横向全身照。人物保持与原图完全一致：面部特征、发型发色、米色西装外套与白衬衫的上半身穿搭原样保留，人物以放松自然的站姿面向镜头，双臂自然下垂，重心落在一侧。由于原图只到腰部，向下补出与上身气质协调的下半身：米白色直筒长裤与浅棕色平底皮鞋，头身比例符合真实成年人。背景中景为卢浮宫标志性的倒三角玻璃金字塔，玻璃面反射傍晚天光，金属框架线条清晰挺括，金字塔脚下是浅灰色碎石步道与修剪整齐的低矮绿篱，远景为米黄色石灰岩墙面与成排拱窗。光线为傍晚暖调自然光，从左前方柔和照射，人物面部与衣物有细腻高光，地面有方向一致的淡淡投影，人物与场景共享同一套光影。整体胶片摄影质感：细密胶片颗粒、暖调复古色彩分级、高光处轻微柔光晕。

将木质招牌上现有的两个黑色毛笔大字"面馆"替换为"茶馆"：左侧面板位置渲染"茶"字，右侧面板位置渲染"馆"字，新字与原字保持完全一致的风格——粗壮的黑色毛笔行草笔触、墨色浓黑、笔画粗壮并带飞白与颜料风化斑驳的质感，字号、位置、排版与原"面馆"两字完全相同。除这两字外，画面其余部分与输入图完全一致：招牌木板的白色旧漆裂纹与剥落纹理、悬挂铁链、右上角大红灯笼及橙红长流苏、檐下的小红灯笼、右侧深色旧木墙与门内景象、左侧远处的老街建筑、电线、天空、左下角人物、地面、光照与拍摄视角均保持不变。
